risk_note: RV2 by path (union). Taobao negative amounts are kept per BR-CALC-26, BR-CALC-02, D10-522 and D10-572. settle_commission_fen and est_commission_fen keep the negative value through yuanStrToFen (mathematical floor); commission_fen and paid_fen take 0 for a negative value. Before this, Reader.fen refused a leading minus: a settled negative pub_share_fee became null so N fell back to the estimate, and negative pub_share_pre_fee or alipay_total_price dropped the row. Other optional amounts and rates are unchanged. Known and out of scope, FU-NEGATIVE-SETTLE-SNAPSHOT: a row first imported as settled does not write settle_commission_fen and an already attributed snapshot is not rebuilt, so this task does not by itself remove the over-crediting risk on those two paths. Taobao has no status map and is not scheduled yet.
